headline: Monsoon Withdrawal Brings Cooling in Northern India, Heat in South
on_air: Good evening, viewers. Today, the monsoon is gradually withdrawing from northern India, bringing cooler temperatures to cities like New Delhi and Lucknow. In the south, however, temperatures are rising, with Hyderabad and Chennai expecting a warm tomorrow. Let's dive into the details. In New Delhi, the temperature is 23.9°C, down from 29.6°C yesterday. This is likely due to the monsoon's retreat. Jaipur, at 30.1°C, will see a high of 34.2°C tomorrow, as the system moves in from the northwest. Lucknow, with 24.6°C, will experience showers, while Ahmedabad, at 32.7°C, will have a drizzle. Bhopal, at 26.8°C, will see overcast skies tomorrow. Kolkata, at 28.6°C, will remain warm with a high of 31.9°C. Nagpur, at 28.1°C, will have partly cloudy skies. Mumbai, at 28.4°C, will see a slight drop to 30.8°C. Pune, at 25.2°C, will have showers, while Hyderabad, at 27.4°C, will remain overcast. Chennai, at 30.6°C, will see a high of 35.0°C. Bangalore, at 25.8°C, will experience drizzle. Tomorrow, the air over New Delhi will head towards Jaipur, while the air over Mumbai will move towards Pune. Stay tuned for updates and remember to pack light clothing for the south and a light jacket for the north. Goodnight.
